notes.note: Edited: clientId requires issuer; writer-wide pins and registry stripping; declared issuer refuses before secret/registration/redirect; RFC 9207 and duplicate-iss 400. Checked against the invariants module, registry.ts, install-registry-integration.ts and tool-server-oauth.ts. Other inputs: the API reference documents issuer required with a client ID, writer-wide pins, registry stripping and RFC 9207 handling; the registry install route refuses to replace a source with a bound OAuth client secret and strips binding references from registry definitions; mcp-service.ts drops its duplicated issuer/endpoint pin checks in favor of the shared storage invariant; plugin-install-transaction.ts only strips secret-binding references (withoutBindingReferences) from a required integration's registry definition before its first save; install order, admission and outcomes are unchanged; the registry install helper refuses to replace a source with a bound OAuth client secret and strips binding references.
